basic_info.description: Spacious Hayes Valley Penthouse with Exclusive Roof Deck    Down-to-the-studs remodel blends modern design with sweeping city views. High ceilings and double bay windows frame an open-plan living/dining area with outlooks from Buena Vista to Twin Peaks and the San Mateo Bridge. The chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry, a breakfast bar island with waterfall edge, quartz counters with Carrera marble design, and premium appliances including Bertazzoni 5-burner range with hood, Samsung dishwasher, and French door refrigerator with ice maker. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and en-suite bath with Porcelanosa tile and floating vanity. Additional bedrooms include one with bay windows and partial downtown views, plus a full bath with Porcelanosa finishes. Enjoy in-unit laundry hookups, tankless water heater, and double-paned windows. Located on Page Street, a designated Slow Street in Hayes Valley, with easy access to Valencia Corridor, Lower Haight, Hayes Street shops/dining, and public transportation.
